package dev.yequi.emotes;

import lombok.Getter;
import net.runelite.api.gameval.SpriteID.Emotes;
import net.runelite.api.gameval.SpriteID.EmotesLocked;

/**
 * Represents an emote in the emotes panel.
 * Ordinals matter for saving EmoteHighlight items in config -> always add new emotes below existing
 */
@Getter
public enum Emote
{
	YES("Yes", Emotes.YES),
	NO("No", Emotes.NO),
	BOW("Bow", Emotes.BOW),
	ANGRY("Angry", Emotes.ANGRY),

	THINK("Think", Emotes.THINK),
	WAVE("Wave", Emotes.WAVE),
	SHRUG("Shrug", Emotes.SHRUG),
	CHEER("Cheer", Emotes.CHEER),

	BECKON("Beckon", Emotes.BECKON),
	LAUGH("Laugh", Emotes.LAUGH),
	JUMP_FOR_JOY("Jump for Joy", Emotes.JUMP_FOR_JOY),
	YAWN("Yawn", Emotes.YAWN),

	DANCE("Dance", Emotes.DANCE),
	JIG("Jig", Emotes.JIG),
	SPIN("Spin", Emotes.SPIN),
	HEADBANG("Headbang", Emotes.HEADBANG),

	CRY("Cry", Emotes.CRY),
	BLOW_KISS("Blow Kiss", Emotes.BLOW_KISS),
	PANIC("Panic", Emotes.PANIC),
	RASPBERRY("Raspberry", Emotes.RASPBERRY),

	CLAP("Clap", Emotes.CLAP),
	SALUTE("Salute", Emotes.SALUTE),
	GOBLIN_BOW("Goblin Bow", Emotes.GOBLIN_BOW, EmotesLocked.GOBLIN_BOW),
	GOBLIN_SALUTE("Goblin Salute", Emotes.GOBLIN_SALUTE, EmotesLocked.GOBLIN_SALUTE),

	GLASS_BOX("Glass Box", Emotes.GLASS_BOX, EmotesLocked.GLASS_BOX),
	CLIMB_ROPE("Climb Rope", Emotes.CLIMB_ROPE, EmotesLocked.CLIMB_ROPE),
	LEAN("Lean", Emotes.LEAN, EmotesLocked.LEAN),
	GLASS_WALL("Glass Wall", Emotes.GLASS_WALL, EmotesLocked.GLASS_WALL),

	IDEA("Idea", Emotes.IDEA, EmotesLocked.IDEA),
	STAMP("Stamp", Emotes.STAMP, EmotesLocked.STAMP),
	FLAP("Flap", Emotes.FLAP, EmotesLocked.FLAP),
	SLAP_HEAD("Slap Head", Emotes.SLAP_HEAD, EmotesLocked.SLAP_HEAD),

	ZOMBIE_WALK("Zombie Walk", Emotes.ZOMBIE_WALK, EmotesLocked.ZOMBIE_WALK),
	ZOMBIE_DANCE("Zombie Dance", Emotes.ZOMBIE_DANCE, EmotesLocked.ZOMBIE_DANCE),
	SCARED("Scared", Emotes.SCARED, EmotesLocked.SCARED),
	RABBIT_HOP("Rabbit Hop", Emotes.RABBIT_HOP, EmotesLocked.RABBIT_HOP),

	SIT_UP("Sit up", Emotes.SIT_UP, EmotesLocked.SIT_UP),
	PUSH_UP("Push up", Emotes.PUSH_UP, EmotesLocked.PUSH_UP),
	STAR_JUMP("Star jump", Emotes.STAR_JUMP, EmotesLocked.STAR_JUMP),
	JOG("Jog", Emotes.JOG, EmotesLocked.JOG),

	FLEX("Flex", ExtraSpriteID.FLEX, ExtraSpriteID.FLEX_LOCKED),
	ZOMBIE_HAND("Zombie Hand", Emotes.ZOMBIE_HAND, EmotesLocked.ZOMBIE_HAND),
	HYPERMOBILE_DRINKER("Hypermobile Drinker", Emotes.HYPERMOBILE_DRINKER, EmotesLocked.HYPERMOBILE_DRINKER),
	SKILL_CAPE("Skill Cape", Emotes.SKILLCAPE, EmotesLocked.SKILLCAPE),

	AIR_GUITAR("Air Guitar", Emotes.AIR_GUITAR, EmotesLocked.AIR_GUITAR),
	URI_TRANSFORM("Uri transform", Emotes.URI_TRANSFORM, EmotesLocked.URI_TRANSFORM),
	SMOOTH_DANCE("Smooth dance", Emotes.SMOOTH_DANCE, EmotesLocked.SMOOTH_DANCE),
	CRAZY_DANCE("Crazy dance", Emotes.CRAZY_DANCE, EmotesLocked.CRAZY_DANCE),

	PREMIER_SHIELD("Premier Shield", Emotes.PREMIER_SHIELD, EmotesLocked.PREMIER_SHIELD),
	EXPLORE("Explore", ExtraSpriteID.EXPLORE, ExtraSpriteID.EXPLORE_LOCKED),
	RELIC_UNLOCK("Relic unlock", ExtraSpriteID.RELIC_UNLOCK_TWISTED,
		ExtraSpriteID.RELIC_UNLOCK_TRAILBLAZER, ExtraSpriteID.FRAGMENT_UNLOCK, ExtraSpriteID.RELIC_UNLOCK_LOCKED),
	PARTY("Party", ExtraSpriteID.PARTY, ExtraSpriteID.PARTY_LOCKED),
	TRICK("Trick", ExtraSpriteID.TRICK, ExtraSpriteID.TRICK_LOCKED),
	FORTIS_SALUTE("Fortis Salute", Emotes.FORTIS_SALUTE, EmotesLocked.FORTIS_SALUTE),
	SIT_DOWN("Sit down", ExtraSpriteID.SIT_DOWN),
	CRAB_DANCE("Crab dance", Emotes.CRAB_DANCE, ExtraSpriteID.CRAB_DANCE_LOCKED);

	private final String label;
	private final int[] spriteIds;

	public String toString()
	{
		return label;
	}

	Emote(String label, int... spriteIds)
	{
		this.label = label;
		this.spriteIds = spriteIds;
	}
}
